  Project: Supply Chain Finance & Trade Digitization Platform Client: Mars Inc. | Yash Technology    
  
Overview: Mars Inc.'s global supplier payment lifecycle spanning PO management, shipment tracking, Letter of Credit issuance, and bank settlement was 
fragmented across enterprise ERP platforms, third -party logistics systems, and banking portals across 15+ countries,  with no unified integration layer 
connecting supply chain operations to trade finance workflows.  
Problem Statement: No unified integration layer existed between Mars's supply chain and their trade finance workflows. LC issuance required manu al 
bank communication, supplier KYC onboarding was entirely paper -based, and finance teams maintained parallel Excel trackers with zero real-time 
transaction visibility resulting in payment delays of 3-5 business days, high reconciliation error rates, and significant compliance risk. Key Contributions:  
• Executed As-Is & To-Be state analysis across the supplier lifecycle from PO creation through LC issuance, KYC validation, and payment settlement 
eliminating 14 manual intervention points via API-driven automation  
• Gathered end -to-end business requirements through stakeholder workshops with procurement, treasury, compliance, and banking teams 
delivering BRD, FRD, User Stories, and RTM covering 120+ functional requirements  
• Authored REST API integration specifications across enterprise ERP , logistics, and banking trade finance portal defining JSON payload structures, 
endpoint contracts, secure authentication flows, and error handling rules  
• Documented KYC/AML validation workflow requirements covering sanctions screening logic, risk -scoring rules, and compliance flag triggers 
ensuring regulatory alignment across 5 jurisdictions and reducing manual compliance effort by 70%  
• Defined and executed UAT test scenarios for LC issuance, payment events, KYC flows, and reconciliation edge cases validated 8 0+ API 
integrations in Postman, achieving zero critical defects at go-live.
